about: Reader-probe questions for the Episode Spec page. Each key and quote comes from decisions.md; `answer` lists every correct choice.

questions.question: Which Option is recommended for Slide 1, "Every token is spent attention"?

choices.c: Neither: the page recommends nothing for that Slide

questions.question: How many Options does Slide 3, "Start fresh when the task changes", offer?
What is the Episode's learning goal?

choices.a: The viewer can name every model that supports a long context window
choices.b: The viewer can explain why an agent forgets in a long session and decide what to put into its context and what to leave out
choices.c: The viewer can build an agent with a larger context window
choices.d: The viewer can measure recall at each position of the window

source.quote: The viewer can explain why an agent forgets in a long session and decide what to put into its context and what to leave out.

questions.question: What does picking an Option on the Title slide item pick?

choices.b: The Title slide and the section slide of every Section, as one set

source.quote: Picking an Option picks the set.
